subject: [PATCH v3 2/4] mm: memcg: read root lruvec stats from the node counters

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the way the root memory cgroup's (memcg) LRU vector stats are read by using the node counters instead of flushing the entire system when possible. This is done for most memcg node stats, which only track memory charged to a memcg, and the root memcg's hierarchical value equals the node counter. However, certain kernel memory stats, hugetlb, and WORKINGSET_NODERECLAIM still require reading the rstat value due to accounting complexities. The patch also updates the way these stats are reported in the cgroup v1 memory.numa_stat, making it more accurate but potentially mismatching with the root memcg's memory.stat.

reviews.author: Chris Down
reviews.summary: Identified potential issues with the allowlist approach, suggesting that the changelog should specify which stats are on the list. Also pointed out a specific stat (NR_VMSCAN_WRITE) that may need to be added to the list.
reviews.raw_body:
Hi Joanne,

Joanne Koong writes:
>The exceptions are the kernel memory stats (slab, kernel stack, page
>tables, secondary page tables and vmalloc), hugetlb, and
>WORKINGSET_NODERECLAIM, which counts reclaimed xarray nodes (slab
>objects). Their node counters also count memory that isn't charged to a
>memcg, which falls into two categories:

This still describes the v2 denylist. With the allowlist, the root memcg
also keeps reading rstat for NR_ANON_MAPPED, NR_FILE_MAPPED, NR_SHMEM et
al, and some of those differ for reasons outside the two categories here,
like swapcache being counted differently in the node counter, for
example. Could the changelog say what is on the list instead? So that
would be the stats that only change through mod_lruvec_state(), with
everything else still reading rstat.

>+	case PGROTATE_ANON:
>+	case PGROTATE_FILE:
>+	case PGREFILL:
>+		return true;

NR_VMSCAN_WRITE isn't on the list, but prepare_scan_control() adds it to
WORKINGSET_RESTORE_ANON, so once the root flush in reclaim goes away,
root reclaim would mix a live node counter with a stale rstat value.
Unless I'm mistaken it should go here as well.

Once those are fixed, please feel free to add:

Reviewed-by: Chris Down <chris@chrisdown.name>

Thanks!

Chris

2026-11-16.patch_summary: This patch series modifies the way root memcg's lruvec stats are read, allowing for more accurate and up-to-date statistics by reading from node counters instead of rstat values in certain cases.
